newsitem.title: UK: BTR says Taiwan polymer sale increases focus.
newsitem.headline: BTR says Taiwan polymer sale increases focus.

text.p: BTR plc said the 191 million stg sale of its 51 percent shareholding in Taiwan Polymer Group will increase its focus on industrial manufacturing and engineering.
It said that, excluding contingencies, the sale increases the total proceeds from its disposal programme to some 900 million stg.

"It also marks further progress towards our objective of focusing on industrial manufacturing and engineering in areas where we have global scale and leadership in product technology," said BTR chief executive Ian Strachan in a statement.
BTR, which is due to announce first-half results on Thursday, said it will receive an initial cash payment of $120 million payable on completion and two subsequent annual payments of $90 million.
The proceeds will be used to invest in the future development of BTR.
The transaction will be with a consortium of USI Far East Corp and Union Petrochemical Corp. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
